taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHAA
Aquifer depth: 18.02 m – 20.11 m (weathered/fractured low-resistivity zone, layers 2–3)
Recommendation: Case off the upper resistive layer (0–18.02 m) and set screen across the 18.02–20.11 m low-resistivity interval, which represents the saturated weathered zone; the underlying high-resistivity sequence (>20.11 m) is interpreted as compact/unweathered basement and is unlikely to yield water unless fracturing is encountered during drilling.
